description: This PHP source file defines a class 'mbinfo' that interacts with system hardware monitoring tools ('healthdc') to retrieve temperature, fan, and voltage data from hardware sensors. It provides methods to parse and return sensor readings and their limits.

classes.name: mbinfo
classes.description: A class for retrieving system hardware sensor information such as temperature, fan speeds, and voltages by executing the 'healthdc' program and parsing its output.

methods.name: temperature
methods.description: Retrieves temperature sensor readings from hardware, parses the output, and returns an array of temperature data with labels, values, limits, and percent utilization.

methods.name: fans
methods.description: Retrieves fan speed readings from hardware, parses the output, and returns an array of fan data with labels, values, minimums, and divisors.

methods.name: voltage
methods.description: Retrieves voltage sensor readings from hardware, parses the output, and returns an array of voltage data with labels, values, and limits.
